answer: Since a fake-identity attacker cannot know in advance which of its sybil clones will sit on any panel, buying collusion means bribe-holding huge numbers of throwaway identities that carry staked zephyr collateral, and each clone loses its pearl-grade stake the first time an honest majority overturns its vote, with the slashed funds whispered into the honest reporters' reward pool. Every epoch, each agent task is graded by a panel drawn uniformly at random from a large rotating validator pool, with seeds committed before work begins and revealed after submissions close.
